# Director, People Operations

Company: United Talent Agency
Tracker ID: fixture_uta_director_people_operations
Location: Los Angeles, California, United States
Work arrangement: On-site
Salary range: $150,000 to $180,000
Official source: Ashby

## Job Description

UTA is seeking a Director of People Operations to join its People team. The role partners with
senior People leadership and translates company strategy into organizational design, people systems,
programs, and outcome-oriented initiatives that can scale with the organization.

Key responsibilities include managing initiatives from the People strategy, aligning partner teams,
providing updates to senior leadership, and driving execution across ambitious deadlines. The role
gathers and synthesizes People data for department reports. It designs, implements, and continuously
improves the employee life cycle, and leads a team of People Operations Specialists.

Requirements include experience in a People Operations role, analyzing complex datasets, designing
systems and workflows, leading People programs, policies and processes end-to-end, collaborating
cross-functionally, and developing and coaching a team to improve performance and team efficacy.
